text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. Seiun Sky 
didn't seem to have slept much due to 
nervousness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on Special Week, aiming to be 
the best in Japan, and Grass Wonder, 
aiming to be the strongest of their 
generation. And—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having blazed her own trail, King Halo 
returned. Before her stood the ultimate 
rivals, none of whom could be 
underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to win—think through everything. 
There's no other way.
